## Comparison table

```{r}
#| label: tbl-pop-comparison
#| tbl-cap: "Summary of population model variants used for sensitivity analysis"

pop_summary <- data.frame(
    Model = c(
        "Meta-analytic (popmodel)",
        "Naive (naivemodel)",
        "Optimistic (optmodel)",
        "H1 (h1model)"
    ),
    `Loading Range` = c("0.37–0.94", "0.48–0.60", "0.64–0.77", "0.21–0.94"),
    `Mean Loading` = c("0.74", "0.51", "0.69", "0.78"),
    `Factor Correlations` = c("0.20", "0.30", "0.08", "0.20"),
    `Residual Range` = c("0.12–0.86", "0.64–0.77", "0.41–0.59", "0.12–0.67"),
    `Q3–Q4 Correlation` = c("0.09", "0.23", "0.16", "0.09"),
    check.names = FALSE
)

kable(pop_summary, align = "lccccc")
```
